name: SKINCOS | 02 Agendamento (Propor / Confirmar)

parameters.query:
insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
values (
  'appointment_requested',
  '{{$json.payload.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$json.payload.conversation_id}}'::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object('mode', '{{$json.mode}}', 'preferences', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.payload.preferences || null) }}'::jsonb),
  now()
);

insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
values (
  'appointment_slots_proposed',
  '{{$json.payload.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$json.payload.conversation_id}}'::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object('slots', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.slots || []) }}'::jsonb),
  now()
);

insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
values (
  'outbound_message_queued',
  '{{$json.payload.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$json.payload.conversation_id}}'::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object('text', 'Propondo horários'),
  now()
);

insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
values (
  'status_changed',
  '{{$json.payload.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$json.payload.conversation_id}}'::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object('status', 'agendamento_sugerido'),
  now()
);

update wa_n8n.conversations
set funnel_status = 'agendamento_sugerido', updated_at = now()
where id = '{{$json.payload.conversation_id}}'::uuid;

insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
values (
  'appointment_scheduled',
  '{{$json.payload.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$json.payload.conversation_id}}'::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object('slot', '{{ JSON.stringify($json.slot || {}) }}'::jsonb),
  now()
);

insert into wa_n8n.appointments (conversation_id, contact_id, unit_slug, calendar_id, calendar_event_id, status, start_at, end_at, timezone, created_at, updated_at)
values (
  '{{$json.payload.conversation_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$json.payload.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$json.payload.unit_slug}}',
  '{{$env.GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID}}',
  '{{$node["10_Create_Google_Event"].json.id}}',
  'agendado',
  '{{$json.slot.start_at}}',
  '{{$json.slot.end_at}}',
  'America/Sao_Paulo',
  now(),
  now()
);

insert into wa_n8n.events (event_type, contact_id, conversation_id, payload, created_at)
values (
  'status_changed',
  '{{$json.payload.contact_id}}'::uuid,
  '{{$json.payload.conversation_id}}'::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object('status', 'agendado'),
  now()
);

update wa_n8n.conversations
set funnel_status = 'agendado', updated_at = now()
where id = '{{$json.payload.conversation_id}}'::uuid;
